# Phase 4 manager acceptance

Accepted exact candidate `f2f1114e81153f1989b93ed148d1204f4e2b9746` after scoped remediation of publication, deployment, Jira reconciliation and required-check progression. Integrated locally by fast-forward; no remote publication occurred.

Manager independently observed the full pinned 267-test/typecheck/build/packed-CLI gate, then focused corrected-path suites: 16 publication/progression/action tests, 10 trusted-Git tests, and 5 deployment tests including actual loopback HTTP smoke, persisted receipt and server-exit cleanup. The implementer additionally observed the exact final head's full 269-test gate. Final differences from independently checked code are the inspected localhost test and construction/evidence records.

Publication uses controller Git context and remote revision observations with effect-time authority checks. Deployment uses bounded explicit environments and separated credentials, durable records and smoke follow-ups. Jira failed or ambiguous reconciliation does not authorize a write; progression accounts for required check identities instead of only the latest observed check.

External GitHub/Jira behavior remains supported by deterministic transport and local fixture evidence, not observed live remote mutation. This limitation must remain explicit in release compatibility claims and whole-system verification. Phase 4 acceptance does not establish the later real Twinzy deployment or final V1 release criteria.

Efficiency: use behavior-level local fixtures before external inference, distinguish installed CLI version from command conformance, and inspect required side effects rather than accepting passing adapter tests as end-to-end proof. Phase5 may now begin from this accepted source. Token estimates are advisory; the owner's remaining account allowance stays binding.
